title: Oscar and the Debt
author: August Thornbury
blurb: Marguerite Delacroix, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
